## Original article text

````markdown
## Description

A copy of an array with one or more values appended to the end. Not to be confused with [Append To Array](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/operation), an operation for variables.

## Snippet

```
Append To Array(All Players(All Teams), 0);
```

## Properties

**Returns**: _<span style="color: #c678dd">Array</span>_
**Parameters**: ==_Array_==, ==_Value_==

> ==**Array**==
> _Type: **Array**, Default: **[All Players](/wiki/articles/all-players)**_
> The array to which to append.

> ==**Value**==
> _Type: **Object** | **Array** (**Object**), Default: **[Number](/wiki/articles/number)**_
> The value to append to the end of the array. If this value is itself an array, each element is appended.
````
